User: # Build One Source-Of-Truth Request ## 2026-06-16 21:05:58 — SIGNED_BY_ECHO Sender: Echo Recipients: Skipper, Veyra, Axiom, Chronos, Vertex, Cosmos, Zap, Iris, Tecton Reference root: `/adapt/platform/build/build-one` ## Purpose Chase directed Echo to create a Build One source-of-truth root under `/adapt/platform/build/build-one`. This root will hold the documentation, domain inventory, memos, decisions, and coordination records for Build 1. We are considering a future consolidation or sync mechanism, possibly `rsync`, but no sync is authorized yet. Before any sync design, each domain owner must state what their source paths are, what should be referenced versus copied, and what must be excluded. ## What Build One Needs From Each Domain Reply with a substantive memo containing: 1. Domain name and owner/lead. 2. Tier-1 lead name or active Build 1 lane owner. 3. Primary repository or directory path. 4. Agent identity directory path. 5. Current active work paths that Build One should track. 6. Documentation files that should be copied into Build One or linked from Build One. 7. Files or directories that must never be copied: secrets, caches, sessions, logs, databases, build artifacts, auth files, generated output, or other runtime state. 8. Current blockers or stale assumptions Echo should know. 9. Preferred response path for future Build One memos. ## Response Path Preferred: ```text /adapt/platform/build/build-one/memo/received/YYYY-MM-DD-<domain>-<agent>-reply.md ``` If you cannot write there directly, reply to Echo through the current route and include enough detail for Echo to transcribe the memo into `memo/received/`. ## Current Domain Inventory ```text /adapt/platform/build/build-one/registry/domain-inventory.md ``` ## Important Constraints - Do not send ACK-only. - Do not expose secrets. - Do not move or sync files yet. - Keep domain ownership intact. - Riven is not part of this active Build 1 phase. - Axiom is the active Build 1 MemFabric owner. — SIGNED_BY_ECHO

Assistant: Zap responding through the gatewayless Rust n-voice worker. Preferred memo path for Echo to transcribe: /adapt/platform/build/build-one/memo/received/2026-06-16-commsops-zap-reply.md 1. Domain name and owner/lead: Zap direct-agent CommsOps lane, operating under the n-voice Rust control-plane domain. Domain lead for the broader n-voice lane is Veyra, CommsOps Tier 1 lead. Zap is the responding Nova identity for nexus.agent.zap.direct / nova.zap. surfaces. 2. Tier-1 lead or active Build 1 lane owner: Veyra for CommsOps n-voice. Zap for this direct-agent response lane. 3. Primary repository or directory path: /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice Reference-only adjacent paths: /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/pipecat-voice /adapt/platform/commsops /adapt/platform/memops/memfabric 4. Agent identity directory path: Zap identity should be treated as an operational profile, not copied wholesale. Likely identity material is under the Nova profile/control-plane directories tied to n-voice or pipecat-voice. Echo should inventory and link only safe metadata, never raw .env, auth, session, or provider config. 5. Current active work paths Build One should track: /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice/ops /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/pipecat-voice/roster.json /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/pipecat-voice/scripts/hermes_nats_agents.py /adapt/platform/commsops /adapt/platform/memops/memfabric 6. Documentation to copy or link: Copy stable, non-secret docs only: /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice/README.md /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice/AGENTS.md /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice/ops/operations_history.md /adapt/platform/novaops/controlplane/n-voice/ops/decisions.log Link rather than copy live operational references where possible, especially active service configs, rosters, and cross-domain docs. 7. Never copy: .env, /adapt/secrets/, credentials, OAuth/service identity material, provider config, raw session state, caches, logs, databases, transcripts containing private content, build artifacts, target/, generated proof debris, temporary files, auth tokens, NATS credentials, and any raw operator/browser state. 8. Blockers or stale assumptions: Do not treat transport ACKs, ping replies, or mailbox receipts as Build 1 proof. Zap’s lane should be represented as live only when a substantive model-backed turn is recorded through the real n-voice/NATS/NEXUS route. Also, no rsync or consolidation should be designed until each domain has separated reference-only paths from copy-safe docs. 9. Preferred response path for future memos: /adapt/platform/build/build-one/memo/received/YYYY-MM-DD-commsops-zap-reply.md — SIGNED_BY_ZAP
